records.title: Panchakshari
records.summary: Village woman Panchakshari (Anushka Shetty), blessed by Goddess Durga, dies in a temple fire. Her husband Sriram finds her lookalike Honey and brings her to the village; Panchakshari's spirit possesses Honey to stop treasure hunters, then leaves her once the villain is defeated.
records.married: not stated (Honey); Panchakshari was Sriram's wife

records.title: Ekkadiki Pothavu Chinnavada
records.summary: In Kerala, Arjun meets a woman calling herself Amala who is really Nithya, possessed by the spirit of Amala, a woman who died in a road accident. The spirit also possesses Parvathi to save her from a forced marriage. The spirit is exorcised and sealed in a bottle; months later Arjun proposes to Nithya and she accepts.

records.title: Three
records.summary: Nisha hears a voice threatening to kill her. Her neighbour Sriram takes her to a psychiatrist friend; they travel to an island where she recalls the sinister Shanker, and the story moves into regression, past births and psychosis.
records.fit_note: Regression is implied by the review; hypnosis not named explicitly
